name: The Clarion's obituary of me
note: EXTRACTED from docs/23-inventory-act1.md (Act II items) by tools/extract-content.mjs. Do not edit: change doc 23 and re-run. E5, the Clarion's front page. Kept. Errata 66 ruling A: shown to the character at C5 and kept; never consumed.

LOOK_AT.say: The Clarion's obituary of THADEUS GRUBBE, piano tuner, 'the only man in town who fixed anything.' Two errors in the name. None in the rest.
repeat: He has spelled it wrong in a new way, and done it carefully. It is the best one yet, and I find I mind it least.
Page one, above the fold, beside an advertisement for coffins. Frame has a sense of order I had not credited.
Nothing. It is the only thing Frame has ever printed that I believe.
